from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,collections,subprocess
root=Path.cwd();task=root/'.local/tool-tasks/stand-pat-witness-observation-20261007'
def read(name):return json.loads((task/name).read_text())
def archive(p):return {'source':p.read_text(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
baseline=json.loads((root/'docs/performance/closed-potion-stock-pruning-20261006.json').read_text())
prior=json.loads((root/'docs/performance/stand-pat-owned-turn-research-20261007.json').read_text())
witness=read('observation-summary.json');repeat=read('repeat-observation-summary.json')
comparisons=[];witness_summaries=[];repeat_summaries=[]
for kind,records in [('witness',witness),('repetition',repeat)]:
 for r in records:
  assert r['status']=='Completed' and r['exitCode']==0 and not r['timeBoundaryObserved']
  b=next(x for x in baseline['finalRuns'] if x['scene']==r['scene'] and x['label'].startswith('C'))
  fields={k:r[k]==b[k] for k in ['rootStampSha256','policy','budget','comparisonQuality']}
  assert all(fields.values()),(kind,r['scene'],fields)
  work={k:{'reference':b['solverMetrics'][k],'observation':r['solverMetrics'][k]} for k in
        ['totalExpanded','totalTransitions','totalChoiceBranches']}
  comparisons.append({'kind':kind,'scene':r['scene'],'same':fields,'work':work,
                      'referenceResultSha256':b['resultSha256'],'referenceDllSha256':b['plan']['dllSha256'],
                      'referenceEvidence':'docs/performance/closed-potion-stock-pruning-20261006.json'})
for r in witness:
 members=[json.loads(s.split('STAND_PAT_WITNESS_AUDIT ',1)[1]) for s in r['mandatoryDiagnostics']]
 wins=[w for m in members for w in m['wins']]
 groups=collections.Counter((w['hp'],w['endedTurn'],w['uses'],w['minUses'],w['hard'],w['currentHp'],w['eligible']) for w in wins)
 witness_summaries.append({'scene':r['scene'],'memberCount':len(members),
   'probes':sum(m['probes'] for m in members),'wins':len(wins),
   'potentialExistingEligibilityTightenings':sum(w['eligible'] for w in wins),
   'groupFields':['hp','endedTurn','uses','memberMinUses','hard','currentBucketHp','potentialTightening'],
   'groups':[{'values':list(k),'count':v} for k,v in groups.items()],
   'members':members})
for r in repeat:
 members=[json.loads(s.split('STAND_PAT_REPEAT_AUDIT ',1)[1]) for s in r['mandatoryDiagnostics']]
 a=members[-1]
 assert a['calls']==a['unique']+a['matches']+a['mismatches'] and a['within']==0
 assert a['mismatches']==0
 repeat_summaries.append({'scene':r['scene'],'memberCount':len(members),
   'rootCumulative':a,'crossMemberRepeatPercent':a['cross']/a['calls']*100,'members':members})
builds={}
for p in task.glob('build-*.log'):
 s=p.read_text();builds[p.name]={'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
  'succeeded':'Build succeeded.' in s,'elapsed':re.findall(r'Time Elapsed (.+)',s)[-1],
  'warnings':int(re.findall(r'(\d+) Warning\(s\)',s)[-1]),'errors':int(re.findall(r'(\d+) Error\(s\)',s)[-1])}
